decisions.reason: Turnaround management software is close to the core offer and featured on its own page, so its uncertain upside is cheap to keep alive in a growing, digitizing market.
Apron connectivity is a low-cost software module that strengthens the integrated platform, and its value is still unresolved only a year after launch.
Billing software sits further from the core airside systems and the firm holds many other options, but the carrying cost is low and the evidence is still too early to justify dropping it.
Equipment monitoring builds on the installed base and supports the service and maintenance strategy, so the option remains valuable at little cost.
Apron resource management is close to the established offer and complements turnaround software, so keeping it costs little while its prospects resolve.
The controller safety alert service fits the firm's tower and safety expertise, and the option is still open with low maintenance cost.
